observed_documentary_facts: SkyAI filed post-T0 pre-commencement issuer-tender communications on October 13, 2026 under Rule 13e-4(c) / SC TO-C.

The communication says SkyAI intends to commence a cash tender at $3.00 per share for up to 95% of each eligible security class, subject to at least 50% of each class being tendered and SOL remaining above $100 during the offer period.
The communication says commencement was expected on or about October 15, 2026 but explicitly says the offer had not commenced and might not commence.
A bounded October 15 search located the SC TO-C/current communication but did not establish a commencement SC TO-I for SkyAI.
No explicit odd-lot priority was found in the pre-commencement communication.
protocol_effect: Protocol A requires the commencement Form SC TO-I itself, exchange-listed operating-company common stock, fixed cash price and explicit odd-lot priority before general proration. SC TO-C cannot be used as EVENT_TIME and cannot authorize market-price access. SkyAI is therefore not claimed and does not block a chronologically earlier qualifying SC TO-I if one exists.
failed_criteria: No qualifying commencement SC TO-I established in this pass.
No explicit fewer-than-100-share odd-lot priority established.
No price-route or post-event entry may be accessed until those gates are met.
next_action: On a genuinely new filing/time delta only, check whether SkyAI files a commencement SC TO-I. If it does, qualify the exact accepted timestamp and read the commencement terms for explicit odd-lot priority before any selected market price.
